method: WebSearch only (standard and extended modes), 38 queries. The container proxy blocks MTG sites and WebFetch cannot resolve external hosts, so no page was opened. IMPORTANT: this WebSearch tool returns a model-written summary of the result pages, with quoted fragments, not raw search-engine snippets. Each 'snippet' field is copied from that summary text, so it is one step removed from the page. Numbers were recorded only where the search output stated them; a_win_rate values marked 'computed from' in notes are W/(W+L) from a W-L record the output stated, rounded to 0.1. Direction convention for mtgdecks.net was checked on three pairings seen from both pages. Many pairings appear twice (once from each deck's page); these are flagged in notes and must not be counted as independent evidence.
blocked: Direct page access to every site (curl 403 from proxy; WebFetch cannot resolve hosts): magic.gg, mtgdecks.net, untapped.gg, mtggoldfish.com, melee.gg, mtgpile.com, basemtg.com, magicmeta.net, openmagic.gg, mydeckstats.com, decklistdata.com
